Amager og Hvidovre Hospital is a regional healthcare facility operating in the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden). It is featured in the 2025 report by the Danish National Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD), which tracks clinical outcomes, surgical interventions, and biological treatments for IBD patients across the country [^src1]. According to the report's technical appendices, Amager og Hvidovre Hospital is distinguished as the facility with the highest number of registered patients receiving biological medical systemic treatments (BMSL) [^src1]. This hospital-level data underpins national quality indicators for biological therapies and surgical practices, providing essential evidence for monitoring treatment variation and evaluating access to advanced care throughout Denmark [^src1].
